title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final answer for the change of entropy as 0.61 cal/K.

title: Correct Formula
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the formula for change of entropy, including the integral of Cv/T.

title: Temperature Conversion
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly convert temperatures from Celsius to Kelvin.

title: Use of Cv
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly utilize the given constant Cv value of 5.85 cal/deg·mole.

title: Natural Log Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must accurately compute the natural logarithm of the temperature ratio.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect temperature conversions.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss limiting cases or assumptions made during the calculation.
